risk_scoring_model.scoring_notes: Scores are assigned on a 1‑10 scale per dimension; overall risk score is the arithmetic mean of the four dimension scores.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Successful login redirects to Dashboard
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Login functionality is core but failure is unlikely and has limited security exposure; impact on business and users is modest.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Password input is masked and not exposed in DOM/network
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Security of password handling is important; exposure would be severe, but the likelihood of a masking failure is moderate.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Invalid credentials display error message without redirect
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Incorrect handling could confuse users and affect support load; security impact is low.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Email format validation prevents submission
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Client‑side validation issue is minor and unlikely to cause business or security problems.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Empty password field triggers client‑side validation
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Similar to email validation; impact is minimal.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Account lockout after exceeding failed login attempts
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Lockout protects against brute‑force attacks; failure would expose accounts and disrupt legitimate users, making it a high‑risk scenario.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Rate limiting headers present on failed login response
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Proper rate limiting is critical to mitigate credential stuffing; missing headers could allow abuse, so it is prioritized high.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Authentication response time under normal load meets performance SLA
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Performance degradation affects user experience but does not pose security or compliance risk.

test_case_risk_scores.title: Login page complies with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and focus order
test_case_risk_scores.risk_rationale: Accessibility issues affect usability and compliance but have limited immediate business impact.
